title: Cognitive Biases in Large Language Models for News Recommendation

bias_targets.methodology: Conceptual analysis of how initial user interactions (the "anchor") disproportionately influence future news recommendations in conversational LLM-based systems.
Conceptual analysis of how the presentation style (framing) of news headlines and summaries skews LLM recommendation judgments.
Conceptual analysis of the tendency for LLM recommender systems to favor familiar content seen during training, thereby reducing the diversity of recommended news articles.
Conceptual analysis of how LLM-based recommender systems might disproportionately associate specific topics or opinions with particular demographic, ethnic, or social groups.
